patterns.statement: Barrier collision is global; the per-agent ignore list gives a true per-player unlock without team changes.
patterns.condition: A barrier must open for one player only in multiplayer
patterns.action: Use barrier_device.AddToIgnoreList(Agent) per unlocking player

patterns.statement: A single source of truth for cost on the native device avoids double-charge and desync between Verse and device config.
patterns.condition: An unlock or purchase is gated by a cost
patterns.action: Let the native Conditional Button own both the requirement and consumption; Verse only reacts to ActivatedEvent

patterns.statement: Immediate saves on frequent events are redundant cost; a dirty-gated autosave bounds writes without losing progress.
patterns.condition: A progress value is saved on frequent events like every kill or tick
patterns.action: Set an IsDirty flag and let a periodic autosave loop (about 30s) write it; save immediately only on rare claim, completion or disconnect events

patterns.statement: Plain classes cannot call GetPlayspace; they signal events and the creative_device manager fans out to players, avoiding a god-object.
patterns.condition: A gameplay subsystem is added to a large game manager
patterns.action: Make it a plain class configured via archetype by the manager, signalling state through events the manager subscribes to

patterns.statement: Boss rounds as a bag-draw with re-rolled gap and a capped multi-boss chance gives variety without repeats; the round must end on either win or wipe.
patterns.condition: A wave loop needs periodic boss rounds without repeats
patterns.action: Use a shuffle bag drawn by random index, a random gap re-rolled after each boss event, hard cap on simultaneous bosses, and race all-bosses-defeated against all-players-down

patterns.statement: UEFN caps persistent vars per project (4 in a real BuildAll error); extend an existing persistable class rather than adding a new one.
patterns.condition: A project needs another persistent per-player value but already uses the persistable weak_map slots
patterns.action: Add fields to the existing persistable class and expose get/set accessors instead of declaring a new weak_map

patterns.statement: Spawner fields only affect newly spawned guards; live HP and elimination events come from fort_character.
patterns.condition: A boss needs scaled HP per round
patterns.action: Write Max/Initial Health and Shield on guard_spawner_device before Enable(), read live HP via the spawned agent's fort_character

patterns.statement: A bucket integer from time makes daily reset idempotent across joins and long sessions.
patterns.condition: Daily goals are offered to players
patterns.action: Compute a reset bucket from unix time and reset hour, re-assign random quests excluding previous ones when the bucket changes, and refresh via a sleep until next reset

patterns.statement: Repeated device reads per slot multiply per second per player; one read per slot cuts them.
patterns.condition: A UI refresh loop reads device state for several slots
patterns.action: Compute each live value once per refresh and pass it to the helpers

patterns.statement: Tracker Complete behavior may reset its value to 0, so a live read after completion can regress progress.
patterns.condition: Quest or progress completion depends on a Tracker Device reaching target
patterns.action: Cache the target value into your own persisted state when CompleteEvent fires, and display max(live value, cached value)

patterns.statement: Widgets added without removal accumulate for the whole session on long matches.
patterns.condition: A pop-up widget is added per event to a player's UI
patterns.action: Spawn a cleanup that sleeps the display duration and then RemoveWidget

patterns.statement: Concurrent BuyOffer/ConsumeEntitlement spawns can double-consume an entitlement; the guard is per player so others are not blocked.
patterns.condition: A purchase can be double-clicked in a UI
patterns.action: Keep a per-player in-flight logic map and ignore the request while set

patterns.statement: Keeping the reward in a per-day trigger keeps the device generic; epoch timestamps survive sessions.
patterns.condition: A recurring reward is claimed once per cooldown
patterns.action: Persist ClaimedDays and NextClaimAtEpoch per player, cycle the 7-day window with Mod, let each day fire its own trigger_device wired to the actual reward

patterns.statement: A Verse event Signal with no subscriber is lost, not queued, so listeners must register first (spawn runs up to its first suspension).
patterns.condition: A coroutine awaits an event another coroutine signals at startup
patterns.action: Spawn the awaiters before the signaller

patterns.statement: Versioned persistable data with a copy constructor lets schema grow without wiping players.
patterns.condition: A persistable class needs a new field after release
patterns.action: Version the class, keep a constructor copying old fields, and migrate in GetOrCreate

patterns.statement: Knocked-down players stay connected, so player count cannot distinguish a natural win from a wipe; an explicit flag is needed.
patterns.condition: A round can end by timer, boss defeat or all players down
patterns.action: Race the win condition against a WaitForAllPlayersDown loop and set a RoundEndedEarly flag, gating the round reward on it

patterns.statement: Immediate reset races the in-flight round loop and a fast rejoin; one grace coroutine at a time.
patterns.condition: All players leave
patterns.action: Wait a 5s grace period, re-check the count, and only then reset; guard with a ResetPending flag

patterns.statement: Quantity and variety grow with pools enabled, with no per-round numeric tuning on each device.
patterns.condition: Round difficulty must scale
patterns.action: Add a fixed duration step per round and enable one more tiered spawner pool every 2 rounds, plus random pools rolled independently from a minimum round

patterns.statement: A Stop-completed timer cannot restart without a reset, so the loop hangs silently after round 1.
patterns.condition: A native Timer Device drives round phases and is reused every round
patterns.action: Call Reset() immediately before every Start() when completion behavior is Stop

patterns.statement: External contracts stay unchanged while the manager keeps only the state machine.
patterns.condition: A manager grows into a god object
patterns.action: Extract horde, economy, boss, hive into plain classes built from the manager's own @editable fields in OnBegin, keep external events and triggers on the manager

patterns.statement: One cheap poll keeps the HUD correct regardless of which system granted the item.
patterns.condition: A HUD shows physical item counts
patterns.action: Poll a Conditional Button GetItemCount every 0.5s instead of per-tick or scattered manual refreshes

patterns.statement: Maps keyed by player never pruned leak on long sessions.
patterns.condition: Per-player maps grow with each joining player
patterns.action: Rebuild the map without the departing player's key in OnPlayerRemoved

patterns.statement: A formula instead of a lookup array covers any number of pools.
patterns.condition: Kills must pay scaling gold
patterns.action: Reward = Base + Step*PoolIndex plus a flat per-round bonus, and give random pools a virtual index after the deterministic ones

patterns.statement: Each native spawner class exposes a different cleanup surface; verify in the digest before mirroring another class.
patterns.condition: A spawner device type has no bulk-eliminate call
patterns.action: Use the type's own cleanup API: creature_spawner EliminateCreatures, guard_spawner Despawn(), wildlife_spawner GetAgents plus Despawn(agent), then Disable

patterns.statement: guard_spawner_device has no device-level EliminatedEvent unlike creature_spawner_device.
patterns.condition: Kill rewards are needed for guard NPCs
patterns.action: Subscribe SpawnedEvent, then await that agent's fort_character EliminatedEvent and read EliminatingCharacter.GetAgent[]

patterns.statement: A per-round roll returned to the loop lets UI messaging reflect the actual round type.
patterns.condition: A round can be an invasion variant
patterns.action: Roll an independent invasion chance that activates all hive and invasion spawners together, and return the result so the round-start message can differ

patterns.statement: Persistent data of a departed player is unreadable; message values are not comparable but player values are.
patterns.condition: A leaderboard must show players who already left
patterns.action: Snapshot their stats and name into a capped FIFO in-memory array at leave time, dedup by the player value on rejoin

patterns.statement: Triggers carry no payload, so amounts need a typed event; custom events are awaited in a loop, not subscribed.
patterns.condition: Several modules need lifetime stats
patterns.action: Store them as extra fields on the single existing persistable class and expose get/set accessors; independent listeners subscribe to the same native trigger and to public events carrying amounts

patterns.statement: Supports several boards and fails soft when the prop is missing.
patterns.condition: A world-space widget is shown in the level
patterns.action: Find placed widget entities with GetSimulationEntity[].FindDescendantEntities at OnBegin and write the same rows to each; log a warning when none is placed

patterns.statement: The widget may not be built yet when PlayerAdded fires; avoids a second duplicate widget.
patterns.condition: Another module needs to push a field to the shared HUD widget
patterns.action: Read the widget through the owner's read-only GetWidget accessor and defer the first push with a short Sleep after join

patterns.statement: ui_input_mode.All captures movement and voice keys; custom events are awaited, not subscribed.
patterns.condition: A widget is a passive HUD that must not block movement or push-to-talk
patterns.action: Add it with ui_input_mode.None and watch its CloseEvent via Await in a spawned task

patterns.statement: Session-scoped one-shot guards stop join/leave exploits; basis-point integer math avoids missing int-float conversion.
patterns.condition: Co-op retention needs a reason to play in a group
patterns.action: Detect party size via Player.GetLocalParty, grant a once-per-session bonus scaled by party size with integer basis points, show a solo nudge after the first completed round

patterns.statement: A creative_device cannot reach the behavior instance; a disconnecting player never fires AgentExitsEvent.
patterns.condition: An NPC persona conversation is per player
patterns.action: Put conversation target and voice channel setup in a custom npc_behavior, locate the device by tag lookup, and tear down on both volume exit and PlayerRemovedEvent

patterns.statement: A repeating ruler over a never-reset counter rewards retention; coroutines are not auto-cancelled on leave.
patterns.condition: Playtime rewards should keep paying for a long session
patterns.action: Track one continuous per-player elapsed counter in a spawned coroutine and repeat the ordered checkpoint list cyclically on top of it, stopping the coroutine via an ActivePlayers map on disconnect

patterns.statement: StopSay and PromptFailure events cannot be scoped to one player in multiplayer.
patterns.condition: Persona events carry no player identity
patterns.action: Treat reset-all-active-widgets as a documented limitation and set a safe unavailable state on prompt failure

patterns.statement: A stale or out-of-order call can never lower a recorded max.
patterns.condition: A maximum value like best round is stored
patterns.action: Write only when the new value is strictly higher

patterns.statement: A gentle exponential (about 1.1x) keeps early levels quick and long sessions meaningful; multi-level jumps must fire per level.
patterns.condition: Prestige levels are uncapped
patterns.action: Use Threshold(L) = Base * Multiplier^(L-1) via an iterative loop, carry excess points over, fire a LevelUp trigger once per level gained

patterns.statement: Tracker persistence and Complete behavior are undocumented traps; the weak_map has documented semantics.
patterns.condition: Persistence must survive a disconnect
patterns.action: Use Epic's persistable class in a module weak_map, auto-loaded on join, instead of Tracker Devices

patterns.statement: A bidirectional using between Verse modules is a package cycle that halts compilation project-wide.
patterns.condition: Two modules would depend on each other through typed device references
patterns.action: Make one direction a signal over shared native trigger_devices and push the outcome through a one-way reference

patterns.statement: A class literal that omits a field resets it to default, silently zeroing other stats.
patterns.condition: A persistable class is written by several setters
patterns.action: Read a snapshot and rebuild the full object carrying every field forward, checking FitsInPlayerMap before set

patterns.statement: Round signals via shared native triggers keep effects decoupled from the manager; Enable alone may not restart a spawner that starts disabled.
patterns.condition: An ambient effect should appear in some rounds
patterns.action: Listen independently to round-start and round-end triggers, roll an activation percentage, enable one random VFX spawner with Enable then Restart, disable it at round end

patterns.statement: Marketplace policy requires paid advantages to be obtainable without payment; one shared grant trigger keeps a single entry point.
patterns.condition: A V-Bucks product could give a gameplay advantage
patterns.action: Also offer a non-monetary path (for example VIP at a prestige level) via a shared trigger that every grant source fires

patterns.statement: One entitlement type and one purchase surface avoids two ownership sources.
patterns.condition: A product could be bought from several surfaces
patterns.action: Expose the entitlement module as public and have the shop reference the same entitlement type as the owning manager

patterns.statement: Verse maps have no key removal; one reusable helper avoids copy-pasted rebuild loops.
patterns.condition: A per-player map needs a key removed
patterns.action: Use a generic WithRemovedKey helper that rebuilds the map via ConcatenateMaps

patterns.statement: A single enable and disable schedule on pre-placed pools gives quantity and variety growth with no per-round device tuning.
patterns.condition: Building a wave survival map from scratch
patterns.action: Place 3 phase timers plus tiered spawner pools disabled at start, then a manager that enables pool N from round 1+2N and disables all at round end

patterns.statement: A shared trigger bus keeps leaderboard, VFX, party and prestige modules independent of the manager.
patterns.condition: Several systems need the same gameplay signal
patterns.action: Fire one shared trigger_device per signal (kill, round start, round complete, diamond earned) and bind it into every listener's own editable slot

patterns.statement: The island time limit and round count are unused when the Verse manager owns the loop.
patterns.condition: Setting up the island for a co-op wave map
patterns.action: Set max players 4, Squads, one island round, and drive the loop from Verse

patterns.statement: The 4 persistent var cap, unbounded per-player maps and empty pool arrays are recurring late failures.
patterns.condition: Before publishing a map with an infinite loop and persistence
patterns.action: Verify persistent var count is at most 4, per-player maps are pruned on leave, and all pool arrays are populated

patterns.statement: A 0.5s poll over all players otherwise allocates a message and writes MVVM every tick for values that rarely change.
patterns.condition: A HUD value is refreshed by a periodic poll for every player
patterns.action: Cache the last value written per player and skip the widget write and log line when unchanged; reset the cache when the widget is rebuilt and prune it on leave

patterns.statement: Disable() is device-wide; refunding the duplicate charge keeps the button usable for other players without a double spend.
patterns.condition: A native device has no per-player disable and a player can re-trigger a paid action already owned
patterns.action: Detect the already-owned state in the activation handler and refund the cost read dynamically from the device (GetItemCountRequired) through an item granter

patterns.statement: GrantItem returns void; the event with an agent-match guard is the only way to detect a silently failed grant on a shared granter.
patterns.condition: An item granter GrantItem call has no return value but a refund or grant must be confirmed
patterns.action: Spawn a race between a loop awaiting ItemGrantedEvent matched to the agent and a 2s timeout that logs a CRITICAL line

patterns.statement: Verse exposes no public task Cancel; race plus a signalled event is the structured way to avoid orphaned suspended tasks across rounds.
patterns.condition: Per-entity coroutines (for example one per boss) must be cancelled when a round ends and task Cancel() is not public
patterns.action: Wrap each task body in a race against a shared event signalled at round end, so the losing branch and everything nested in it is cancelled

patterns.statement: Without a cap each earn adds a widget and a sleeping task for the display duration; the cap bounds UI and task cost and the reward is unaffected.
patterns.condition: Kills or rewards can fire pop-up widgets many times in quick succession
patterns.action: Keep a per-player counter in a weak_map, skip the cosmetic pop-up over a cap (default 8) and release the slot in the spawned cleanup after the display duration
